version.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

llm.summary: This skill is mostly an Azure speech-to-text guide, but its trigger instructions are mismatched and it asks users to use cloud-accessible audio without strong privacy scoping.

dimensions.detail: Cloud transcription and Blob URLs fit the purpose, but the artifact only lightly discloses that audio must be remotely accessible, including a public Blob URL recommendation, without clear privacy, access-control, or retention guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is limited to a documented Python package install and environment variables for Azure endpoint/key; no executable artifact scripts or obfuscated installer behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger wording is broader than the stated transcription purpose and could route unrelated requests to a skill that uses exec, write access, Azure credentials, and remote Blob-hosted audio.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background workers, persistence hooks, privilege escalation, local credential-store access, or hidden long-running behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The main content describes Azure-based audio transcription, timestamps, and subtitle output, but the trigger condition tells agents to use it for text translation, multilingual conversion, and localization, which the skill does not actually implement.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use this only for Azure speech-to-text tasks, not general translation or localization. Do not place sensitive recordings in public Blob URLs; prefer tightly scoped, time-limited access where possible, and confirm Azure credential handling, storage access, and retention expectations before processing private audio.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted: the artifact-backed trigger line points to translation/localization tasks while the rest of the skill is for speech transcription.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted: the broad trigger scope is not aligned with the concrete audio transcription examples and can cause surprising invocation.
[SQP-2] expected: Partially accepted: Azure/Blob processing is expected for this skill and is mentioned, but the privacy and access-control implications are under-explained for user audio.
